title: A Study to Assess the Long-Term Safety and Efficacy of Lebrikizumab in Participants 6 Months to <18 Years of Age With Moderate-to-Severe Atopic Dermatitis (ADorable-2)
official: J2T-MC-KGBJ/DRM06-AD16 A Phase 3, Multicenter, Long-Term Extension Study to Assess the Safety and Efficacy of Lebrikizumab in Participants 6 Months to <18 Years of Age With Moderate-to-Severe Atopic Dermatitis
summary: Main objective: To describe long-term safety of lebrikizumab in pediatric participants with moderate-to-severe AD
criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
